episodes.title: The Magic That Started Everything
episodes.summary: Coco, a girl fascinated by magic, meets Qifrey and discovers the secrets of witches.

episodes.title: The School of the Grassland
episodes.summary: Coco meets her fellow students and starts to learn the fundamentals of magic.

episodes.title: The Dadah Range Test
episodes.summary: While Qifrey is away, Agott pushes Coco into taking a dangerous test.

episodes.title: Meetings in Kalhn
episodes.summary: Qifrey takes Coco to the witches' town of Kalhn, where she has an unexpected encounter.

episodes.title: The Dragon's Labyrinth
episodes.summary: The four apprentice witches strive to find a solution to their calamitous situation.

episodes.title: A Light on a Rainy Day
episodes.summary: On a rainy day, the apprentices enjoy a picnic outside and meet their Watchful Eye.

episodes.title: Who Is Magic For?
episodes.summary: The apprentices are allowed to come along on a dangerous rescue mission.

episodes.title: The Misgivings of the Knights Moralis
episodes.summary: When the Knights Moralis arrive, Coco and Agott must deal with the aftermath of their actions.

episodes.title: A Nightmare Stained in Black
episodes.summary: Qifrey investigates a new clue to the Brimmed Caps while Coco continues to struggle with guilt.

episodes.title: A Promise in Silver
episodes.summary: Keyfree and Tata take Coco, who has fallen ill, to the hospital. Tata has become suspicious of Keyfree's recent behavior and tries to confront him about it, but he evades her questions. Meanwhile, she learns that Coco, despite being an "unknown," has become Keyfree's apprentice, and she feels a complex mix of emotions as she relates it to her own situation as someone with "silver-colored disease." That night, while Keyfree is busy responding to a fire in the town, Tata searches the medicine storage room for a drug that is difficult to distinguish by anything other than color in order to save Coco, whose condition has worsened.

episodes.title: The Test in Serpentback Cave
episodes.summary: "My specialty is drawing straight lines." Coco, her eyes shining, intently reads the textbook, her mind even more focused on studying magic. Meanwhile, Riche shows no interest in looking at or trying to memorize the magic in the textbook. Keyfree gently urges her to look at the textbook, but Riche gets angry and storms out of the room. Just then, news arrives at the atelier about the second "Pentagram Test."

episodes.title: The Shadow of Romonon
episodes.summary: Agate and Riche, along with Yuini, a wizard's apprentice from another atelier, take the second test, "A Knight's Loyalty." However, while Agate is eager to pass as quickly as possible, Riche seems unenthusiastic. Following the instructions of the test supervisor, Alaila, the three proceed along the path of the Serpent's Back Cave, trying not to let their identities be discovered by the sea beast bird (Melphon) they are protecting.

episodes.title: Forbidden Magic
episodes.summary: Agate, Riche, and Yuini are separated from Alaila due to an attack by the "Hari-hat" group. They try to escape their pursuers by using the magic each of them can use to cooperate... Meanwhile, Keyfree, Coco, and Tetia, who were waiting outside, become aware of the situation when Alaila sends out an SOS, but are attacked by the enemy, and Keyfree is seriously injured while protecting Coco and Tetia.
